summary: Re-verified network stability after backend supervisor restart. Backend API healthy (login 200). Browser E2E confirmed NO 'Network Error' toast across admin login, kader11 login, and all 5 admin nav pages (Dashboard, Daftar Prioritas, Keluarga & Sasaran, Import Data, Master Pertanyaan). All data fetches succeeded. Import Data and Master Pertanyaan menus are present in the sidebar and open correctly.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in ImportData.jsx dynamic kader/wilayah select options (injected by visual editor wrapper). Non-blocking, but produces console error.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend --reload with rm-rf'd cwd caused prior crash; consider disabling --reload in production supervisor config to avoid getcwd FileNotFoundError.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form has no button[type=submit]; use [data-testid=login-submit-button] or role=button name=Masuk. Username input testid: login-username-input. Admin nav testids: admin-nav-{dashboard|prioritas|keluarga|import|master}. Failed requests to /__emergent_overlay__/report and /cdn-cgi/rum are external telemetry noise, ignore.
rca of the issue: Prior 'Network Error' was caused by uvicorn --reload holding a deleted CWD after /app/backend was rm-rf'd and recreated, triggering FileNotFoundError on os.getcwd() and intermittent backend downtime. A clean 'supervisorctl restart backend' re-anchored CWD and restored service. Verified: login + 5 admin pages + kader login all succeed with no Network Error toast.
